meta.title: AIA Vote
meta.description: Aadhaar-gated, verifiable e-voting prototype built on a permissioned blockchain.

common.notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.

home.title: Vote from anywhere without revealing who you are
home.subtitle: Aadhaar proves you are eligible. A zero-knowledge proof keeps your vote secret. Both are written to a public ledger you can check yourself.
home.explainerFootnote: You keep a receipt. The receipt lets you prove your own vote was counted — without revealing which candidate you chose to anyone else.

steps.proofBody: Your vote travels as a zero-knowledge proof (Semaphore). The ledger never sees your name, your Aadhaar number or your address.
steps.nullifierBody: Every vote carries a single-use nullifier, so one person can only ever cast one vote in an election.
steps.chainTitle: Your vote is on the record
steps.chainBody: The candidate you picked is recorded publicly. Your identity is not linkable to it.
steps.auditBody: Electronic polling booth scans are compared against the ledger tally automatically, and any difference is published.

vote.title: Cast your vote
vote.subtitle: Check eligibility, register anonymously, and cast a secret ballot.
vote.loadError: We could not load this election. Check that the backend is running.
vote.ballotHint: These are the candidates on record. The voting steps continue below.
vote.proving: Generating your secret proof… this takes a few seconds.
vote.relaying: Sending your vote to the ledger…
vote.voteDoneBody: Your choice is on the public ledger. Your identity is not linked to it.
vote.nullifierHint: Save this somewhere safe. It is the only way to look up your receipt, and it cannot be linked to you.
vote.notInGroup: Your registration has not reached the ledger group yet. Wait a moment and try again.
vote.noIdentity: No voting identity on this device. Register during the Registration phase first.
vote.registrationBody: This election is still registering voters. You will be able to cast your vote once the Voting phase opens.
vote.closedBody: This election is in the {phase} phase. Follow the count on the turnout page.
vote.kycBody: Prototype check only: enter a mock EPIC. No real Aadhaar or DigiLocker is involved, and the number itself is never stored.
vote.epicInvalid: That EPIC does not look right. Use the SS/DD/DDD/DDDDDD format.
vote.identityBody: This creates the secret key that proves you may vote without revealing who you are. It never leaves this device.
vote.identityBackup: Demo only: the key is kept in this browser. Clearing site data loses it.
vote.registerBody: Only your anonymous commitment is sent to the ledger. Nobody can link it back to you.
vote.registerDone: Registered. Come back to this page once the Voting phase opens.
vote.alreadyRegistered: Already registered for this election — you can vote once the Voting phase opens.
vote.regClosedBody: This election is already voting, so new registrations are no longer accepted. You needed to register during the Registration phase.
vote.stepError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

receipt.stub: Look up a receipt using the nullifier printed in your voting confirmation.

explorer.title: Public explorer
explorer.stub: Browse elections, votes and nullifiers straight from the ledger.
explorer.votesEmpty: No votes have been recorded for this election yet.
explorer.searchLabel: Search loaded votes by nullifier or vote hash
explorer.searchPlaceholder: Paste a nullifier or vote hash…
explorer.searchEmpty: No loaded votes match “{query}”. Load more votes or check the receipt page.
explorer.loadError: We could not load votes. Check that the backend is running.
explorer.verifyBody: Fetch every vote, recount them here in your browser, and compare with the official tally. This never reveals anyone's identity — votes are public by design.
explorer.verifyMatch: MATCH — the browser recount equals the official tally.
explorer.verifyMismatch: MISMATCH — the browser recount differs from the official tally.
explorer.verifyHidden: The official tally is published when the election reaches Tallying. The browser recount is shown below for now.
explorer.verifyError: We could not fetch all votes. Try again.
explorer.verifyCapped: Stopped after {count} votes (safety cap) — the recount below is partial.
explorer.auditsBody: Booth EVM counts compared against the chain tally, newest first.
explorer.auditsEmpty: No audit runs have been recorded for this election yet.

admin.title: Admin
admin.stub: Election management for Election Commission staff. Wallet connection is required here and nowhere else.
admin.walletNotice: Admin actions are signed with an ECI multi-sig wallet.
admin.connectBody: Only ECI multi-sig owners can sign. Voters never connect a wallet.
admin.demoNotice: Demo only: a public Hardhat test key on the local chain. Never use it anywhere else.
admin.wrongNetwork: Wrong network — this panel targets chain {expected}, but the wallet is on chain {actual}.
admin.noSwitch: Your wallet cannot switch networks automatically. Switch to chain {expected} by hand.
admin.notOwner: This wallet is not a multi-sig owner. You can inspect pending transactions but cannot sign.
admin.proposeSuccess: Proposed as transaction {id}. Owners can now approve it above.
admin.alreadyPending: An identical transaction is already pending (transaction {id}).
admin.txCreateElection: Create the {constituency} election with {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}.
admin.txAdvancePhaseBare: Advance election {election} to the next phase.
admin.msNotOwner: This wallet is not a multi-sig owner, so it cannot sign this transaction.
admin.msAlreadyApproved: You have already approved this transaction. A second owner still needs to approve it.
admin.msThresholdNotMet: Not enough approvals yet. Wait for more owners to approve before executing.
admin.msTxNotFound: This transaction does not exist on the multi-sig.
admin.msExecutionFailed: The election call inside this transaction would fail (for example, the phase already changed).
admin.noNode: Could not reach the local chain at {url}. Start Hardhat with `npx hardhat node` first.
admin.needsElection: Enter a constituency and at least two candidates.
